spans.s:
--three kinds of persons according to their nature; hence गुणत्रयम्; satva प्रकृति, राजस prakr2ti and तामस prakrti. Their different characteristics. A muni [page१-537+ ३२] serves satva and conquers rajas and tamas.
1: भा. XI. २५. 9-३५.
If the three states are normal it is प्रकृति, प्रधान or avyakta. If in a condition of agitation, three deities Brahma, विष्णु and शिव are the result.
2:

. १४-6.
Twelve qualities;
3: वा. ६२. २४.
twenty-six in num- ber; yoga, साङ्ख्य, tapas, विद्या, vidhi, क्रिया, ऋतम्, satyam, अहिम्सा, ध्यानम्, सान्ति, अविद्या, mati, धृति, कान्ति, स्मृति, medha, लज्जा, शुद्धि, sarasvati, तुष्ति, पुष्ति etc., all in ब्रह्मा.
4: Ib. २३. ५४.
--the five senses and the five प्राणस् and the mind of the मुक्त leave him; a ज्ञानिन् does not take another body like the seeds burnt. वा. १०२. १०५-06.
--a वानर chief; son of श्वेत. Br.
